name: Shemaroo Entertainment Limited
about: Shemaroo Entertainment Limited engages in the distribution of content for broadcasting of satellite channels, physical formats and digital technologies in India. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of contents, including films, television shows, web series, play, devotional, bollywood music, regional entertainment, and children's content; operates ShemarooMe, a video over the top (OTT) platform; and distributes its content to domestic satellite, cable, and terrestrial platforms. It also involved in the immersive technology business; and provides DTH, music, studio, and film production services, as well as inflight entertainment solutions. Shemaroo Entertainment Limited was founded in 1962 and is based in Mumbai, India.
